records.title: R200-REC-04869 RFI 00127 TPSS PSE Coordination
records.description: During coordination regarding electrical service to the traction power substations, PSE presented the attached letter titled “Follow-up Response to 6/1/2020 Memo TPSS Power Demand on Utility Coordination” dated 03/29/2021 as the basis of their protection design. This letter was sent from Sound Transit to PSE to provide expected AC Current Demand. The Current Demand provided within the referenced letter does not allow operation of the Traction Power Transformer Rectifier Unit within the extra Heavy Traction Duty Cycle as required within specification 34 21 16.26. Loading provided in Letter Loading required per Specification Continuous Notprovided 154 A (100%) 2h Notprovided 231 A (150%) 15m in 149 A Notprovided 5min Notprovided 461A (300%) Imin 301 A Notprovided 15s 415 A 692 A (450%) >ls Notprovided 1846A (1200%) Unless the utility protection settings are updated to allow the loading required per specification, the AC Protective Relay inside each TPSS would have to be set so that it does not allow operation of the referenced duty cycle.

records.title: R200-REC-04732 RFI 00130 E31 Switchboard NEMA Rating
records.description: SWK is working on procurement for SWBD-01 at the E31 Station. There is conflicting information about the requirements for this equipment: Specification section 26 24 13 2.01 B.10 calls for switchboard enclosures to be NEMA 1. Drawing E31-EPS953 calls for Switchboard enclosures to be NEMA 12. DCM chapter 23 calls for switchboard enclosures to be NEMA 12. However, no manufacturer makes a NEMA 12 switchboard enclosure, they are only produced in NEMA 1 or NEMA 3R. A 3R enclosure will add doors to the enclosure, SWK has verified that the equipment size will still work with the current room layout. Please confirm if a NEMA 1 or NEMA 3R enclosure is acceptable for E31-SWBD-01.
records.provenance: User-provided 10-RFI demo sample; verify source and current status.

records.title: R200-REC-04734 RFI 00133 EP29 FACP Location
records.description: PR 7.1.3.2.3 directs SWK to place the Fire Alarm Control Panel (FACP) at the EP29 Garage in the Electrical Room. This does not conform to City of Redmond Fire requirements to have the FACP in the Fire Sprinkler Riser Room (FSRR). This conflict was raised by SWK during the design phase with alternative solutions presented. After presenting this in the Task Force Meeting SWK was directed on 02/14/2020 to leave the FACP in the electrical room and RFD would accept this. The design proceeded as such to the IFC milestone. During review of the fire alarm permit drawings in April 2022, RFD said they will not approve the design without the FACP in the FSRR. A meeting was held on 5/13/2022 to determine the direction to allow RFD to approve these permit drawings, it was determined that the FACP needs to relocated to the FSRR, with the connection to the ST DDC and EVS needs to be maintained. Please confirm and provide appropriate change direction that SWK should proceed with design and construction rework to change the location of the FACP from the Electrical Room to the FSRR at EP29.
records.provenance: User-provided 10-RFI demo sample; verify source and current status.

records.title: R200-REC-05234 RFI 00137 Signal House Hasp Requirements Removal
records.description: In pushing for final approval for signal houses on R200 through the Labor and Industries (L&I) Gold Seal process, the third-party reviewer for L&I (BHC) has stated that the following spec 34 42 38 2.01 D.2 (shown below) violates IBC / WAC 1010.1.9.4 - Locks and Latches. The reviewer has clearly stated that L&I will not approve or attach any seal for a latching system that does not allow for egress when locked. The reviewer will not move plans forward until the hasp is removed or noted that it will not be installed during the manufacturing of the building. 34 42 38 2.01 D.2: Securely fasten a ¼ inch by two inch angle plate on the exterior of all instrument house doors with provisions made for a vandal proof lock to secure the door angle plate to an angle plate securely fastened on the instrument house. Provide this locking arrangement in addition to the normal locking mechanism and handle.

records.title: R200-REC-08674 RFI 00201 Decorative Flat-Work and Seat Wall Mock up IFC Changes
records.description: During the decorative concrete flat-work and seat wall mock up walk, ST expressed interest in two changes to IFC design. 1 - Medium Etch Sierra Finish After the mock-up review walk, Sound transit expressed interest in changing the medium etched color 5 Sierra finish to a broom finish on the following pages, E29-LHD101 to E29-LHD104. Please provide direction if Sound Transit would like to revise current finish for Color 5 Sierra on the pages listed above. 2- Seat Wall Skate Stops Currently the approved IFC drawings show a depressed skate stop in the seat walls per PR 7.13.8.1G.1, see 4/E29-LHD101 & 4/E31-LHD102. SWK/LaRusso constructed a mock-up to match the IFC detail. In mock-up review walk, Sound Transit and the installing contractor expressed concerns about the long term visual appearance of the skate stop as the depression has the possibility to chip over time. Please provide direction if Sound Transit would like to revise design to a post installed skate stop.

records.title: R200-REC-10360 RFI 00257 Hilti HAD-PF M12 Buy America Waiver Request
records.description: SWK is requesting a Buy America Waiver for the Hilti HDA-PF M12 undercut anchors to be used in the installation of OSD per NCR 203, REC 09872. SWK has pursued other buy America anchors for this scope of work but were unable to find an anchor that met the spec requirements under 03 15 25. The Hilti HDA-PF M12 undercut anchors have been approved under NCR 203, REC 09872 and meet all project requirements. Quantities are shown on page 6. The total material value for these anchors is $4,375.04 and the estimated labor cost for install is $1,997.04, totaling $6,372.08 for both labor and material. We have not reached out to Hilti for a letter showing best efforts as we know they have other anchors that could meet buy America However, those anchors don’t meet the other requirements called out in the 03 15 25 spec. These anchors we are trying to use are called out in the spec, (see page 2) hopefully this will be a satisfactory documentation/justification. NOTE: we are resubmitting the same content for previously approved RFI-00246 (Security Fencing Top Rail to Top of Mesh Clarification, was incorrect) We are updating the title to match the content. The content has not changed. RFI-00257 will supersede RFI-00246.

records.title: R200-REC-01874 RFI 00081 Radio Enhancement System Question on DAS Antennas in Elevators.pdf
records.description: Sound Transit DCM Section 15, 25.4.1, E, 3 requires antennas for elevator cars in underground stations. R200 has only above ground stations. Standard Spec Sections 14 21 00, 2.03, G, I, 5 and 14 24 00, 2.03, J, 5 require the following: "Radio Antenna: Provide mounting provisions for a Commprod antenna and cabling from the car to the interface terminal cabinet in the machine room for Sound Transit provided radio antenna in the elevator cab." Contract Spec Section 27 60 02 requires coverage in elevator cabs and has specifications for 50/75 ohm transformers for matching impedance traveling cables for elevators. Previous discussions with Sound Transit indicated needing radio antennas in elevator cabs. However, more recent discussions with Vertical Transportation Design and Construction partners and Sound Transit have suggested that elevator inspectors are rejecting radio antennas in elevators.
records.provenance: User-provided 10-RFI demo sample; verify source and current status.
